Source-labelled tensile elongation at break(%); strain estimator/convention, reference gauge actually used and rupture/point selection unknown. No percent-to-fraction, stretch-ratio or strain-rate conversion; standard citation does not establish independent compliance.

evidence.locator: PDF p.16 Table 7 PNA-BPF-1 row x Tensile Elongation at Break (%); p.6 section 2.5.1 tensile protocol; p.5 section 2.4 cure

source_discrepancies.description: Table 1 labels the nominal feeds HCP:BPF:ECH as 1:8:16 through 1:24:16, while the listed reagent mole amounts and the section 2.2.1 statement about a constant 16-fold ECH excess do not establish a consistent normalized ratio.
source_discrepancies.disposition: Preserve the printed ratio labels as nominal source recipe labels. Do not recompute ECH amounts, repair the ratios, infer the intended denominator or claim validated feed stoichiometry or final composition.

evidence.locator: PDF p.4, section 2.2.1 opening paragraph and Table 1

source_discrepancies.description: Table 1 lists HCP as 35 (0.086) g (Mole) for PNA-BPF-2, but as 35 (0.101) for PNA-BPF-1 and PNA-BPF-S.
source_discrepancies.disposition: Keep the PNA-BPF-2 source label and its printed nominal 1:9:16 recipe without silently correcting the mass or mole entry. No recalculated composition is emitted.

evidence.locator: PDF p.4, Table 1, HCP g (Mole) column, PNA-BPF-2 versus PNA-BPF-1 and PNA-BPF-S

source_discrepancies.description: Section 2.1 names potassium hydroxide, whereas the synthesis headings, Table 1 and sections 2.2.1-2.2.2 describe NaOH or sodium hydroxide.
source_discrepancies.disposition: Retain the contradiction. The selected route is source-described batch addition of solid alkali; the alkali chemical identity is not independently resolved or silently changed from KOH to NaOH.

evidence.locator: PDF p.4, section 2.1 alkali entry, section 2.2.1 heading and Table 1; p.5, sections 2.2.1-2.2.2

source_discrepancies.description: PDF abstract reports a maximum tensile elongation at break up to6.22%, whereas Table7 selected PNA-BPF-3 cell prints6.2%.
